verdict.rationale: Combined CPU+GPU offload is a fair question for a local LLM runtime, but the evidence never documents splitting a model across CPU and GPU to exceed VRAM. The pack only shows general GPU acceleration (Metal, NVIDIA, AMD, Vulkan) and CPU-only inference, which are adjacent features. One community user with 8GB VRAM saw mostly CPU processing and asked how to shift work to the GPU, with no documented partial-offload mechanism in reply.
